column1: # The workspace this engine's committed answers come from. Databricks is an
# account service: there is no image and no container, so image names the
# workspace host, digest is the SHA-256 of what SELECT VERSION() answered, and
# the source tag names the SQL release, the SQL warehouse and the catalog the
# tests record against. The token is never part of a pin.
# columns: role, image, digest, source tag
